about.title: About Us
about.story: Naouma makes bedroom and bedding products for quiet, everyday use: cotton sheets, bed covers, pillows, and blankets chosen to suit Egyptian homes.
about.story2: Each collection is designed as part of a complete bedroom — calm colours, comfortable fabrics, and practical details that hold up to nightly use.

values.title: Fabric Quality
values.text: We choose fabrics that stay soft and keep their finish after repeated washing.

values.title: Calm Design
values.text: Simple colours and lines that fit bedrooms of every style.

values.title: Practical Details
values.text: Clear sizing and easy-care fabrics so everyday use stays comfortable.

product.description: Designed to be a comfortable part of your daily routine: soft fabrics, calm colours and considered details that last.
product.detailsBody: Soft cotton fabrics with a comfortable hand feel, carefully stitched edges and clear sizing for different bed sizes.
product.careBody: Wash cold with similar colours, tumble dry low, and avoid bleach to keep the fabrics soft.
product.shippingBody: We prepare your order within one business day, then ship it with a tracking number. Shipping is free on orders above EGP 3,000.
